verdict.rationale: Antigravity has no named bulk-operations feature, but it offers building blocks for acting on many items at once. It runs multiple agents in parallel across independent projects (docs-1, docs-10) and delegates extensive codebase work to subagents (docs-18). The headless CLI can script agent tasks in CI (docs-50), and scheduled tasks run agents on a cron (docs-2). Missing for 10: a documented batch or multi-select operation over many files or items, examples of fan-out bulk edits, and independent or hands-on confirmation that bulk runs work at scale.
